substeps.caption: The Kardex Shuttle XP 500 as it would stand in the lab: a closed cabinet, 2780 mm wide, 3074 mm deep and 3950 mm tall, with one large access opening at counter height and the operator console beside it.
Inside, drawn see-through from here on: the front storage column, the extractor's shaft and the rear storage column, with the three empty trays in their slots.

The operator rolls up: a Universal Robots UR10e with a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper on a MiR250 mobile base, parked square to the opening. Its 1300 mm reach covers every seat it works on from here.
